title: Fractional Brownian motion with multivariate time: persistence exponents
summary: We consider fractional Brownian motion with D-dimensional time in the domain G(T)=(-T 0 if j<d+1). Let P(T) be the probability that the process will not exceed a fixed level in G(T). We show that for large T, logP(T)=(D-dH)logT(1+o(1)) where H is the Hurst parameter of the process
